title: UN's Guterres recalls Nepal glacier warning as climate risks grow

blocks.text: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres recalled his warning about Nepal’s rapidly melting glaciers on Tuesday, saying the climate impacts he had cautioned about during his 2023 visit to the Himalayas were now arriving sooner and hitting harder. “Three years ago, in the mountains of Nepal, I sounded the alarm on accelerating glacier melt, warning that the rooftops of the world are caving in,” Guterres told the opening of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York. “Some dismissed it all as overstating dangers,” he said. “But as tragic events have shown, impacts are arriving sooner, hitting harder, and spreading […]...
